title: Mrs. Ilana Alouf: "Parashat Noah"

chapters.title: Introduction to Parashat Noah
chapters.about: Eleh toldot Noah and the flood

chapters.title: Noah as a Tzaddik and Shomer Ha-Brit
chapters.about: The importance of guarding the brit

chapters.title: The Corruption of the Generation
chapters.about: Adultery and gezel as causes for the Mabul

chapters.title: The Structure and Power of the Tevah

summary: Mrs. Alouf discusses the character of Noah as a tzaddik who guarded his brit and the reasons for the Mabul, including corruption and gezel. She compares Noah to Avraham Abinu, noting their different approaches to influencing their generations, and explores the spiritual significance of the tevah and the waters of the flood.
questions: Why was Noah considered a tzaddik in his generation?
What was the primary cause of the Mabul?
How does the role of Noah compare to that of Avraham Abinu?
What is the spiritual significance of the tevah?
Why did the fish survive the flood?
